support_verified_hint: Band layout checked on real recordings of this record.
support_partial_hint: Bands of known kinds, recognised by their signal; not yet checked on a recording of this record.
support_none_hint: vinyl-check cannot use the bands of this record.
no_reference_hint: No 1 kHz tone on both channels at a reference level: good for adjusting, but the turntable cannot be accepted with this record alone.
band_reference: 1 kHz on both channels in phase, at the record's full reference level (0 dB, about 5–8 cm/s), not at −20 dB
band_azimuth: 1 kHz on the left channel only and on the right channel only
band_phase: 1 kHz vertical (the channels out of phase)
band_speed: 3150 Hz, at least 10 seconds (3000 Hz is not recognised yet)
band_tracking: A tone at 250–400 Hz whose level rises continuously (bands in steps are not recognised yet)
band_response: A sweep on both channels rising to at least 8 kHz, or 10 kHz and 100 Hz tones
band_resonance: A vertical sweep falling from 200 Hz or higher to below 40 Hz
band_vta: Two tones together: 60 Hz and 4 kHz (SMPTE intermodulation)
band_silent: A silent groove of at least 30 seconds
